title: Impact of Proximity to Hazardous Waste Facilities on Asthma Prevalence by Census Tract in North Carolina
research_question: How does proximity to hazardous waste facilities influence spatial patterns of asthma prevalence across census tracts of North Carolina, and how do these relationships vary spatially by socioeconomic and demographic context?
research_intent: To assess the influence of proximity to hazardous waste facilities on the spatial distribution of asthma prevalence across census tracts in North Carolina, considering variations based on socioeconomic and demographic factors.

steps.description:
Answer the research question end to end: How does proximity to hazardous waste facilities influence spatial patterns of asthma prevalence across census tracts of North Carolina, and how do these relationships vary spatially by socioeconomic and demographic context?

Research question breakdown:
- Intent: To assess the influence of proximity to hazardous waste facilities on the spatial distribution of asthma prevalence across census tracts in North Carolina, considering variations based on socioeconomic and demographic factors.
- Brief description: This research aims to explore if living near hazardous waste sites is associated with higher asthma prevalence in North Carolina's census tracts, and examine how this association varies with socioeconomic and demographic variables.
- Category: explanatory
- Spatial scale: Census Tract
- Data requirement: ["Georeferenced locations of hazardous waste facilities", "Asthma prevalence rates per census tract", "Socioeconomic and demographic data per census tract"]

Do all data preparation, analysis, and visualization this requires in one script, and save the key quantitative results to analysis_results.csv.
